timing_status: Illustrative playback timing; no operating speed or cycle time is qualified

keyframes.label: Ready
keyframes.detail: Tube seated in the open donor frame.

keyframes.label: Ready
keyframes.detail: Tube seated in the open donor frame.

keyframes.label: Bottom contact
keyframes.detail: The robot turns the shaft; the pusher takes up the 2 mm gap.

keyframes.label: Tube ejection
keyframes.detail: The shaped bottom pusher lifts the tube 28 mm into the open receiver.

keyframes.label: Receiver capture
keyframes.detail: The closing cam raises the wedge and closes both receiver halves.

keyframes.label: Latch engages
keyframes.detail: The spring bolt enters the collar window; the receiver is retained.

keyframes.label: Confirm capture
keyframes.detail: Pause at 220° to confirm the tube and latch; confirmation is illustrated here.

keyframes.label: Confirm capture
keyframes.detail: Pause at 220° to confirm the tube and latch; confirmation is illustrated here.

keyframes.label: Pusher retracts
keyframes.detail: The cam completes its turn; the latched receiver keeps holding the tube.

keyframes.label: Receiver departure
keyframes.detail: The robot lifts the complete latched receiver and tube away from the station.

keyframes.label: Tube held in receiver
keyframes.detail: The latch holds the collar closed while the station followers are clear.

keyframes.label: Receiver returns
keyframes.detail: The robot returns the still-latched receiver to the station.

keyframes.label: Restore bottom support
keyframes.detail: Reverse the main cam to 210°; pusher and closing follower support the load again.

keyframes.label: Pull latch · 4.5 mm
keyframes.detail: With the tube supported, the robot pulls the latch handle fully outward.

keyframes.label: Quarter turn · 90°
keyframes.detail: The robot turns the pulled cross-pin into the bayonet hold-open pockets.

keyframes.label: Open receiver and lower tube
keyframes.detail: Reverse the main cam to zero; the receiver opens and the pusher lowers the tube.

keyframes.label: Untwist latch
keyframes.detail: With the tube seated, untwist the latch while keeping it pulled.

keyframes.label: Rearm latch
keyframes.detail: Release the pull; the bolt rests against the open collar stem, ready for the next cycle.

keyframes.label: Reset complete
keyframes.detail: Tube seated, receiver open, main cam at zero: the starting state is restored.

limitations: Robot inputs are illustrated; no robot arm, gripper path or hardware controller is simulated
Capture confirmation is an assumed animation event, not a sensor reading
Rigid motion only; spring/contact dynamics, torque, fit and fluid optics remain unqualified
The final untwist and spring return rearm the latch; the animation ends in the exact initial state
